{"code": "import os, time, nanosurf

# Initialize SPM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode

# Set scan parameters (20 µm x 20 µm, 128x128)
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6
scan.Points = 128
scan.Lines = 128

# Set operating mode to tapping (PhaseContrast) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set filename mask for saved image
filename_mask = "AFM_20x20_128_"
app.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(filename_mask)

# Determine output directory (gallery folder)
# Assuming default gallery path is the current working directory
output_dir = os.getcwd()

# Start scan (upwards)
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to finish
while scan.IsScanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning... remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(2)
print("Scanning finished")

# After scan, find the most recent file matching the mask
files = [f for f in os.listdir(output_dir) if f.startswith(filename_mask)]
if not files:
    print("No image files found.")
else:
    # Get newest file by modification time
    newest = max(files, key=lambda f: os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(output_dir, f)))
    full_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(output_dir, newest))
    print(f"Image saved at: {full_path}")

# Clean up
spm = None"}
